title: File:Pohutu Geyser erupting.jpg
claims: The image shows Pohutu Geyser erupting at Te Puia / Whakarewarewa, with a column of white steam and water, a pale silica terrace, ferns and trees.
The file title identifies Pohutu Geyser; it contains no Tarawera race, UTMB or race-day context and is a location photograph, not the start arch or race coverage.
The author is Pseudopanax at English Wikipedia, and the file is public domain; the original is 4,896 x 3,264 pixels and 4,580,647 bytes, dated 2018-01-26.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 re-encoded Commons thumbnail of 133,489 bytes and credits the author and public-domain status; no crop or colour change was applied.
